page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90 is a high-memory compute instance driven by AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it provisions 90 dedicated vCPUs spanning 45 physical cores with two threads per core. The instance is allocated 720.0 GB of system memory, yielding an expansive ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16 extensions), AES, VAES, and SHA-NI cryptographic acceleration. It does not include local disk storage or dedicated GPU accelerators, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data workloads.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate exceptional multi-threaded performance and strong memory throughput. The instance achieves top-tier results in PassMark CPU tests (87,517.3), software compilation via Clang (60,172.0), and extended instruction handling (115,339.44). In memory-intensive scenarios, read operations reach 218.2 GB/sec on large uncached memory blocks and 6,374.57 GB/sec within cached reads. High-concurrency operations remain robust, demonstrated by 117.38 million Redis SET operations per second and 57.08 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. While single-threaded scores place within the median tier, overall parallel processing is reinforced by top-quartile Geekbench multi-core and stress-ng results.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of memory per core makes this instance resource-effective for memory-constrained workloads without demanding hyper-scale compute footprints. However, the lack of bundled local NVMe storage and included IPv4 addresses necessitates external provisioning for I/O operations and public routing. The configuration is primarily tailored for in-memory databases, large Redis clusters, extensive data transformation pipelines, and CPU-based vector embedding processing.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90 is a memory-optimized cloud server powered by 4th Gen AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. Configured with 90 dedicated vCPUs across 45 physical cores and 720.0 GB of RAM, it establishes an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-heavy computing. The processor supports advanced AVX-512 vector extensions, BF16, and hardware-accelerated encryption instructions. In synthetic and application benchmarks, the c3d-highmem-90 records top-tier results in Clang software compilation, PassMark multi-threaded execution, and vector-intensive extended instruction sets, supported by read memory bandwidth exceeding 218 GB/sec on large blocks. The system operates without integrated local storage or GPU hardware, relying on persistent remote storage. With substantial memory capacity and high multi-core scaling, this instance fits large in-memory databases, distributed caching nodes, memory-bound enterprise applications, and multi-threaded analytical compilation workloads.
